ABOUT.TITLE: Über PatTool
ABOUT.SUBTITLE: Full-stack platform for sportive events, friends, tools, IoT and the world — designed and built end to end.
ABOUT.INTRO: PatTool is a private social network for organizing sportive activities, with discussions, photo wall, calendar, AI assistant, geo tools, media watchers and home automation.
ABOUT.FEATURES_DESC: Jump to a module. Everything below is available from the application menus.

ABOUT.API_DESC: RESTful API with OpenAPI / Swagger documentation
ABOUT.MONGODB_DESC: Cloud NoSQL document database with authentication
ABOUT.DISCUSSION_DESC: Real-time discussion via WebSocket (STOMP/SockJS) with backend persistence (Spring Boot).

ABOUT.SSL_DESC: Secure communication with TLS certificates in production
ABOUT.RESOURCES_DESC: Documentation, administration consoles and repositories used by this deployment.
ABOUT.STREAMING_ARCHITECTURE_DESC: Hybrid streaming system with client-side caching
ABOUT.STREAMING_OVERVIEW: The system uses a hybrid approach: backend streams ALL events once via Server-Sent Events (SSE), frontend caches ALL events in memory, and displays only 8 at a time with client-side pagination.
ABOUT.STREAMING_BACKEND_DESC: Backend streams all matching events from MongoDB via SSE, one by one, in real-time.
ABOUT.STREAMING_FRONTEND_DESC: Frontend caches all events in memory. Scrolling uses cached data — no backend calls.
ABOUT.STREAMING_BENEFITS_DESC: Fast scrolling with no network latency, instant display of next pages, offline-ready, instant search/filter on cached data.
ABOUT.STREAMING_APPROACH_DESC: Stream once, cache all, client-side pagination
